title: Pyare Lal Bhargava v. State of Rajasthan

content.caseIdentity: Pyare Lal Bhargava v. State of Rajasthan, AIR 1963 SC 1094
content.holding: Criminal breach of trust: entrustment is the hinge. Without entrustment you are in misappropriation or theft, not s. 316.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India 1963 Supp (1) SCR 689; AIR 1963 SC 1094; 1962 INSC 297; Section 378 IPC temporary deprivation constitutes theft.
